cypher: MATCH (n:T_NHP) WHERE toLower(toString(n.Species)) CONTAINS $species_keyword AND EXISTS { MATCH (flow:T_D_FLOW)-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..12]->(n:T_NHP) WHERE toLower(toString(flow.Instrument)) CONTAINS $flow_instrument } AND EXISTS { MATCH (seq:T_D_SEQ)-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..12]->(n:T_NHP) WHERE toLower(toString(seq.Sequencer)) CONTAINS $seq_sequencer } RETURN n.id AS id, n.uuid AS uuid, n.type AS type, n.Name AS name, n.Species AS species ORDER BY id LIMIT 5000
reply_head:
There are 56 Non Human Primate samples from *Macaca fascicularis* that have both flow cytometry data run on a Cytek and sequencing data run on a NovaSeq.
